arxiv-2106-09526.title: Exploring the Properties and Evolution of Neural Network Eigenspaces during Training
arxiv-2106-09526.creator: Mats L. Richter, Leila Malihi, Anne-Kathrin Patricia Windler, Ulf Krumnack
arxiv-2106-09526.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mats L. Richter, Leila Malihi, Anne-Kathrin Patricia Windler, Ulf Krumnack. In this work we explore the information processing inside neural networks using logistic regression probes Alain and Bengio 2018 and the saturation metric Richter et al. We show that problem difficulty and neural network capacity affect the predictive performance in an antagonistic manner, opening the possibility of detecting over- and under-parameterization of neural networks for a given task.

arxiv-2110-10954.title: Magnetohydrodynamic winds driven by line force from the standard thin disk around supermassive black holes: II. a possible model for ultra-fast outflows in radio-loud AGNs Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2110-10954.creator: Xiao-Hong Yang
arxiv-2110-10954.description: Abstract In radio-loud active galactic nuclei (AGNs), ultra-fast outflows (UFOs) were detected at the inclination angle of ∼ 10 o \sim 10^{\rm o} – 70 o 70^{\rm o} away from jets. Except for the inclination angle of UFOs, the UFOs in radio-loud AGNs have similar properties to that in radio-quiet AGNs.

arxiv-2111-01980.title: Tadpole contribution to magnetic photon-graviton conversion
arxiv-2111-01980.creator: N. Ahmadiniaz, F. Bastianelli, F. Karbstein, C. Schubert
arxiv-2111-01980.description: Abstract Photon-graviton conversion in a magnetic field is a process that is usually studied at tree level, but the one-loop corrections due to scalars and spinors have also been calculated. Differently from the tree-level process, at one-loop one finds the amplitude to depend on the photon polarization, leading to dichroism.

arxiv-2311-17347.title: Data-driven Bandwidth Adaptation for Radio Access Network Slices Thanks: .
arxiv-2311-17347.creator: Panagiotis Nikolaidis and Asim Zoulkarni and John Baras
arxiv-2311-17347.description: Abstract The need to satisfy the QoS requirements of multiple network slices deployed at the same base station poses a major challenge to network operators. The problem becomes even harder when the desired QoS involves packet delays. In that case, network utility maximization is not directly applicable since the utilities of the slices are unknown.

arxiv-2503-07688.title: Transitional supersolidity in ion doped helium droplets
arxiv-2503-07688.creator: Juan Carlos Acosta Matos, P. Giannakeas, Matteo Ciardi, Thomas Pohl, Jan-Micheal Rost
arxiv-2503-07688.description: Abstract 4 He nanodroplets doped with an alkali ion feature a snowball of crystallized layers surrounded by superfluid helium. For large droplets, we predict that a transitional supersolid layer can form, bridging between the solid core and the liquid bulk, where the 4 He density displays modulations of icosahedral group symmetry.

arxiv-2506-10744.title: 𝙾𝚋𝚏𝚞𝚜𝙱𝙵𝙰 \mathtt{ObfusBFA} : A Holistic Approach to Safeguarding DNNs from Different Types of Bit-Flip Attacks
arxiv-2506-10744.creator: Xiaobei Yan, Han Qiu, Tianwei Zhang
arxiv-2506-10744.description: Abstract . Bit-flip attacks (BFAs) represent a serious threat to Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), where flipping a small number of bits in the model parameters or binary code can significantly degrade the model accuracy or mislead the model prediction in a desired way.

arxiv-2511-08002.title: Implementation and application of a DFT + U +U + V +V approach within the all-electron FLAPW method
arxiv-2511-08002.creator: W. Beida, G. Bihlmayer, C. Friedrich, G. Michalicek, D. Wortmann, S. Blügel
arxiv-2511-08002.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by W. Beida, G. Bihlmayer, C. Friedrich, G. Michalicek, D. Wortmann, S. Blügel. We present an implementation of the density-functional theory DFT + U +U + V +V formalism within the all-electron full-potential linearized augmented-plane-wave (FLAPW) method as implemented in the FLEUR code. The DFT + U +U + V +V formalism extends DFT, supplemented by the onsite Coulomb interaction U U , to address local correlation effects in localized states by incorporating intersite Coulomb interaction terms V V .

arxiv-2512-03642.title: Evaluation of Foundational Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials for Migration Barrier Predictions
arxiv-2512-03642.creator: Achinthya Krishna Bheemaguli, Penghao Xiao, Gopalakrishnan Sai Gautam
arxiv-2512-03642.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Achinthya Krishna Bheemaguli, Penghao Xiao, Gopalakrishnan Sai Gautam. Fast, and accurate prediction of ionic migration barriers ( E m E_{m} ) is crucial for designing next-generation battery materials that combine high energy density with facile ion transport.

britannica-1911-consett.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-consett.description: Article 'Consett' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 6), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. division of Durham, England, 20 m. of Newcastle-upon-Tyne by a branch of the North Eastern railway. It is the centre of a populous industrial district. At Shotley Bridge (where there is a small spa) a colony of German metal-workers, making swords and knives, was established in the 17th century; but this industry has now been replaced by paper mills.

pmc-10615104.title: Workplace Belonging of Women Healthcare Professionals Relates to Likelihood of Leaving
pmc-10615104.creator: Judith D Schaechter, Richard Goldstein, Ross D Zafonte, Julie K Silver
pmc-10615104.description: PurposeThere is a high rate of attrition of professionals from healthcare institutions, which threatens the economic viability of these institutions and the quality of care they provide to patients. Women professionals face particular challenges that may lower their sense of belonging in the healthcare workplace.

pmc-10716195.title: Improving the efficiency of using multivalued logic tools: application of algebraic rings
pmc-10716195.creator: Ibragim E Suleimenov, Yelizaveta S Vitulyova, Sherniyaz B Kabdushev, Akhat S Bakirov
pmc-10716195.description: It is shown that in order to increase the efficiency of using methods of abstract algebra in modern information technologies, it is important to establish an explicit connection between operations corresponding to various varieties of multivalued logics and algebraic operations.

pmc-10751312.title: Bacterial and fungal bioburden reduction on material surfaces using various sterilization techniques suitable for spacecraft decontamination
pmc-10751312.creator: Shunta Kimura, Shu Ishikawa, Nobuya Hayashi, Kazuhisa Fujita, Yuko Inatomi, Shino Suzuki
pmc-10751312.description: Planetary protection is a guiding principle aiming to prevent microbial contamination of the solar system by spacecraft (forward contamination) and extraterrestrial contamination of the Earth (backward contamination). Bioburden reduction on spacecraft, including cruise and landing systems, is required to prevent microbial contamination from Earth during space exploration missions.

pmc-11509710.title: Predicting Intra- and Postpartum Hemorrhage through Artificial Intelligence
pmc-11509710.creator: Carolina Susanu, Anamaria Hărăbor, Ingrid-Andrada Vasilache, Valeriu Harabor, Alina-Mihaela Călin, Simone Ferrero
pmc-11509710.description: Background and Objectives: Intra/postpartum hemorrhage stands as a significant obstetric emergency, ranking among the top five leading causes of maternal mortality. The aim of this study was to assess the predictive performance of four machine learning algorithms for the prediction of postpartum and intrapartum hemorrhage.

pmc-12363540.title: Adult Hospitalized Mycoplasma Cases in a Tertiary Hospital in Japan
pmc-12363540.creator: Masafumi Seki
pmc-12363540.description: BackgroundMycoplasma infections have increased globally, including in Japan. Severe pneumonia due to Mycoplasma pneumoniae (M. pneumoniae) that is resistant to macrolides has been reported in the post-COVID-19 period, but its pathogenesis and detailed treatment regimens are still unclear.Case SeriesFour adult cases of M. pneumoniae pneumonia that required admission to the hospital in the 2024–2025 season are presented.

pmc-12625930.title: Self-reported sexually transmitted infections among adults in South and Southeast Asian countries: a multilevel analysis of recent DHS data (2015–2023)
pmc-12625930.creator: Kebede Gemeda Sabo, Kusse Urmale Mare, Begetayinoral Kussia Lahole, Beriso Furo Wengoro, Habtamu Solomon Demeke, Ausman Ahmed Mohamed, Mohammed Abdurahman Bilal, Abdulkerim Hassen Moloro
pmc-12625930.description: AbstractObjectiveTo assess the pooled prevalence of self-reported sexually transmitted infections (STIs) and their associated factors among adults in South and Southeast Asia, using the Demographic and Health Survey data collected between 2015 and 2023.DesignA community-based cross-sectional study design was conducted using a multistage cluster sampling approach.

pmc-13399023.title: Circulating microRNA signatures of cachexia and cancer in Canis familiaris as a comparative oncology model for human disease
pmc-13399023.creator: Soon‐Seok Park, Kyongman An, Gyeonghwa Kim, Soo‐Nyun Choi, Hong‐Ki Lee, Keun Hur, Kyu‐Shik Jeong
pmc-13399023.description: Cachexia, a severe muscle‐wasting syndrome, lacks objective biomarkers for early detection. This study aimed to identify circulating microRNA signatures for cachexia and cancer in senior dogs, a comparative oncology model for human disease. Serum microRNA expression was quantified in a cohort of 25 dogs, clinically classified by cachexia and cancer status.
